purpose: Force root-cause-first debugging across repo, runtime, machine, workflow and external-service boundaries.
siiaos_additions: Start by naming the exact failing observation and environment.
Separate desired state, repository state, deployed state and runtime state.
For named machines/services, do not infer identity or role from stale context.
Trace component boundaries before proposing a fix.
Record each hypothesis and the evidence that falsifies or supports it.
After repeated failed fixes, reassess architecture instead of stacking patches.
Use verification-before-completion before declaring the incident resolved.
positive_triggers: bug, failing test, broken workflow, inconsistent runtime behavior
negative_triggers: greenfield architecture with no observed failure
simple how-to question with no malfunction
acceptance: no fix proposed before at least one concrete observation is captured
multi-component failures identify the boundary being tested
failed hypotheses are not silently rewritten as successes
resolution claim cites fresh verification evidence
